task_description: The installable package renders a reduced approximation of each report instead of the report the workshop measured, and backend-sis has grown ~1700 lines of compensation code to work around that. Converge the two: extend the packaged layout so it carries what the fixture already measured, and reduce backend-sis to supplying data and receiving PDF bytes. Three measured defects drive this. (1) BANDS DROPPED: tools/package_resources.py::_transplanted_header keeps only page-1 row 0 (the letterhead) and the first _is_label_row, discarding every band between them. Exactly 3 of 46 reports are affected - secondary/school-results loses 5 rows (the DIVISION PERFORMANCE SUMMARY table), primary/school-results loses 13 (grade matrix, school average, pass/fail, competency band, council rank, region rank, a section heading), primary/region-ufaulu-masomo loses 2. The heading survives while the table beneath it does not. (2) NO MEASURED PAGE-1 CAPACITY: layout.json carries one rows_per_page and applies it to every page. For secondary/school-results the reference's own page 1 carries 26 candidate rows and its fullest continuation page carries 39, and the distilled rows_per_page of 39 is therefore CORRECT for continuation pages - the single number is simply applied to page 1 as well, where only 26 fit. Re-measured 2026-09-23: the earlier figure of '36 on continuation pages' was wrong on two counts - it read page 2, which is not the fullest page (37 rows against 39 on pages 3-13), and it subtracted a label row that continuation pages do not carry. Page 1 needs its own capacity because its band is taller: the true front band measures 168.20pt against the distilled header's 111.05pt, so dropping the summary band understated page 1 by 57.15pt. Placing 39 rows on page 1 puts the table bottom at 718.52pt on a 612pt page with the true band (106.52pt past the box) or 661.37pt with the truncated one (49.37pt past); either way rows spill, and a 44-row render produced 35 + 9 instead of 26 + 18. FEAT-001 measured this corpus-wide: 7 reports overflow their page box today. (3) REFERENCE CONTENT AS DEFAULT: layout.json ships the measured strings (MWANZA REGION, the 2026 exam title, the sample school) addressable only as "row.col", and bindings.yaml/calibration.json are excluded, which is why backend-sis carries headers.py (407 lines of regex line classification with SAMPLE_LOCATIONS = ("MWANZA CC","MWANZA") hardcoded, duplicated again in resolve.py) and bindings.py (1306 lines of hand-typed per-report column orders plus a binding_matches_layout self-check). The design target is not invented: backend-sis HEAD c6fa6313 contains template/spec.py (488 lines), whose TemplateSpec/Region/RowBand model already expressed full page-1 head, continuation_head measured from page 2, first_page_rows AND rows_per_page both measured never computed, per-row row_offsets/row_paths, spanning column rules and tints, and named slots. Converge the packaged layout onto that vocabulary. corpus/ stays read-only, fidelity THRESHOLDS are never relaxed, and no service is restarted and no migration is run anywhere in this task.

verification.summary: To be completed by FEAT-008. Gate: make check-resources clean, uv run pytest green in the mussannoni repo, the 3 compound reports reproduce the reference's page-1 band count and column grid, no report's generated page-1 table exceeds its measured page box, no measured reference figure survives into generated output unfilled, and backend-sis imports and generates with headers.py and bindings.py deleted.

superseded: FEAT-009 is withdrawn and FEAT-002/FEAT-003 are superseded in DIRECTION by FEAT-010, which renders from the measured document instead of reconstructing a flat approximation. The work already landed in FEAT-002/003 stays useful: header.fields (column identity) is what makes safe substitution possible, and both features' findings record the measurements that justify FEAT-010.
